propositions: Detached pytest runs (nohup) report test failures that do not reproduce in foreground runs, causing false positive regressions.

The root cause is concurrent external mutation of the shared checkout (file creation, HEAD moves, signal-killed child processes) being misattributed to innocent tests by isolation guards rather than detachment itself being faulty.
The _no_repo_root_leaks autouse fixture cannot distinguish between in-test and external mutations of REPO_ROOT, and silently deletes external mutations, destroying concurrent agent artifacts.
Browser e2e tests fail silently when killed by signal because the diagnostic checks stderr without inspecting proc.returncode, masking the true cause (external kill) as a product failure.
Documentation for recommended detached test execution practices is absent, making the undocumented folklore practice unsafe for agents sharing checkouts.
Detached runs are trustworthy when run in a dedicated worktree with no concurrent checkout mutations, and the guards must report external causes honestly rather than attributing them to tests.
